sourceNote: Reconciled against origin/main at 9d7b2fd after PRs #45 through #57 merged with green CI. The atomic-write wave is repository-complete; production access, credentials, owner decisions, and downstream revenue flows remain visibly human-gated.

waves.name: Stabilize
waves.goal: Land or close the three aging pull requests and verify production health.

waves.name: Make writes atomic
waves.goal: Ratify and ship the Postgres transaction path that removes the dominant audit risk.

waves.name: Clear owner gates
waves.goal: Collect the decisions, credentials, and vendor approvals that agents cannot invent.

waves.name: Finish revenue flows
waves.goal: Build membership, identity, time-bank, tournament registration, and communications.

tickets.title: Bound Supabase auth middleware failures
tickets.summary: PR #48 added a three-second timeout so a paused or unreachable Supabase project no longer takes down public pages.
tickets.nextAction: Keep the timeout regression tests in the release gauntlet.
acceptanceCriteria: PR #48 is merged to main.
Marketing routes degrade without a 504 when auth is unavailable.
Authenticated routes redirect safely when the session cannot be resolved.

tickets.title: Repair and land rate-limit middleware
tickets.summary: PR #46 landed the root middleware rate-limit wiring after rebasing over the Supabase timeout work and passing the full release gate.
tickets.nextAction: Preserve the rate-limit headers and backstop checks in the release gauntlet.
acceptanceCriteria: PR #46 is rebased on current main without weakening PR #48.
Format, lint, typecheck, unit, E2E, Lighthouse, and backstop checks pass.
Preview responses carry X-RateLimit headers.
PR #46 is merged or explicitly closed with a replacement reference.

tickets.title: Ratify the tournament schedule ADR
tickets.summary: PR #45 ratified ADR-0037 and established the feature-flagged tournament schedule rollout contract.
tickets.nextAction: No further ratification action; preserve the static fallback and flag-gated rollout contract.
acceptanceCriteria: ADR-0037 status and implementation spec agree.
The static fallback and feature-flag rollout remain explicit.
PR #45 is merged before PR #47 is rebased.

tickets.title: Rebase and land tournament schedule Slice 1
tickets.summary: PR #47 shipped tournament schedule Slice 1, including migration 0017, the materializer route, admin controls, flag-aware pages, and regression coverage.
tickets.nextAction: Keep the flag-off fallback and tournament fixture backstop in the release gauntlet.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration 0017 applies cleanly after current main.
All PR checks and the spec gauntlet pass after rebase.
The tournament fixture backstop remains clean.
PR #47 is merged.

tickets.title: Roll out the live tournament schedule
tickets.summary: PR #51 registered the nightly Vercel cron, but the database-backed schedule must stay flag-off until production secrets, project linkage, migration, materialization, and manager smokes are verified.
tickets.nextAction: Owner/operator adds production CRON_SECRET and redeploys, confirms the active production Supabase project and migration 0017, runs one authenticated materialization, verifies at least one future row per active template, smokes manager pause/resume/cancel plus flag-off/on /games, and only then enables tournament-schedule-live.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one scheduled row exists per active template.
A manager can pause, resume, and cancel from /admin/tournaments.
Flag-off and flag-on /games paths both render correctly.
The tournament-schedule-live flag is enabled only after verification.

tickets.title: Close the Supabase incident loop
tickets.summary: PR #52 added PII-free successful-auth latency telemetry and an incident note, but credentialed production smoke testing and an evidenced Supabase root cause still require human-held access.
tickets.nextAction: Using the designated test-member credentials and Supabase dashboard access, run sign-in, one gated route, and sign-out in production; correlate supabase_auth_ok latency with Supabase logs; document an evidenced cause or leave it explicitly unproven; change the three-second budget only from measured data.
acceptanceCriteria: The upstream outage cause is documented with evidence.
Production marketing and authenticated routes are smoke-tested.
The timeout budget is retained or changed from measured latency.
A follow-up incident or runbook note is committed.

tickets.title: Ratify the production transaction adapter
tickets.summary: PR #50 ratified ADR-0040, selecting the production Postgres.js transaction boundary, its runtime and secret posture, rollback contract, test seam, and migration inventory.
tickets.nextAction: Keep ADR-0040 as the required contract for future audited production writes.
acceptanceCriteria: The ADR names the driver, pooling/runtime posture, secrets boundary, and rollback behavior.
It defines one transaction interface used in production and tests.
It lists every non-atomic mutation that must migrate.
Owner review questions are isolated from implementation details.

tickets.title: Implement the production transaction adapter
tickets.summary: PR #53 shipped the server-only Postgres.js transaction runner with rollback, rethrow, cancellation, connection reuse, and an injectable test seam.
tickets.nextAction: Repository work is complete; before production use, owner/operator provisions preview or staging SUPABASE_DATABASE_URL on the transaction-mode port 6543 endpoint and records one real rollback and commit integration result.
acceptanceCriteria: A thrown audit insert rolls back its paired mutation.
A thrown mutation never writes an audit row.
Production does not use the fake transaction implementation.
Connection cleanup and request cancellation are tested.

tickets.title: Migrate high-risk actions to atomic writes
tickets.summary: PRs #55 and #56 moved flags, member administration, refunds, privacy, verification, tournament controls, and materialization onto the production transaction runner.
tickets.nextAction: Repository migration is complete; deploy the migrated paths only after per-environment SUPABASE_DATABASE_URL is provisioned and the LUNA-007 staging integration passes.
acceptanceCriteria: Every listed mutation and its audit row commit or roll back together.
Existing action taxonomy and PII-redaction tests remain green.
No service-role access is widened.
The implementation status notes stop describing these writes as best-effort.

evidence.label: Merged privacy and tournament migration PR #56

tickets.title: Run the atomicity regression gauntlet
tickets.summary: PR #57 completed the rollback and ordering matrix across admin, privacy, verification, payments, tournaments, materialization, RLS, cancellation, PII taxonomy, and audit-log surfaces.
tickets.nextAction: Keep the rollback matrix and the LUNA-009 journal in the release gauntlet; production execution remains subject to the deployment gates recorded on LUNA-004, LUNA-007, and LUNA-008.
acceptanceCriteria: Focused rollback tests fail against the old path and pass against the new one.
Full typecheck, lint, format, migration safety, and Vitest suites pass.
Admin accessibility suites remain green.
A journal entry records the migrated actions and residual exceptions.

tickets.title: Provision Stripe test and production configuration
tickets.summary: Membership, time-bank, and registration flows remain blocked on keys, products/prices, webhook secrets, and an approved rollout posture.
tickets.nextAction: Owner grants test and production access to the already-selected payment platform and provisions products, prices, webhook endpoints and secrets, and deployment environment values; Luna records only non-secret identifiers and validates one signed test webhook.
acceptanceCriteria: Test and production accounts are identified.
Membership price IDs and webhook endpoints exist.
Secrets are stored outside git in the deployment environment.
A test webhook delivery verifies signature handling.

tickets.title: Confirm the identity-verification launch path
tickets.summary: ADR-0009 is accepted and selects manual review for v1; launch still requires owner staffing and SLA confirmation plus counsel decisions on e-sign sufficiency and ID retention.
tickets.nextAction: Owner confirms the accepted manual-review v1 staffing and SLA, counsel resolves e-sign and ID-retention questions, and automated vendor selection stays deferred unless the owner explicitly opens that decision.
acceptanceCriteria: The accepted manual-review v1 workflow has named staffing and an approved SLA.
Counsel-approved e-sign, retention, deletion, and breach responsibilities are documented.
The verification state machine and fallback path remain ratified.
Required storage and review access is available without committing credentials.

tickets.title: Clear email, SMS, and A2P gates
tickets.summary: ADR-0025 is accepted; operational launch remains blocked on sending-domain authority, business-registration inputs, communication access, and the decision to complete SMS registration or launch email-only.
tickets.nextAction: Owner supplies sending-domain and DNS authority, legal business-registration inputs, phone-number posture, and existing communication access; Luna validates email and, only if registration permits, SMS STOP/HELP, consent, and delivery behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The sending domain is verified.
A2P brand/campaign paperwork is submitted or an email-only launch is approved.
Test email and SMS delivery succeeds.
STOP/HELP and consent requirements are captured.

tickets.title: Resolve PokerAtlas and TableCaptain posture
tickets.summary: ADR-0013 is accepted with manual reconciliation as the v1 default; a future bridge remains blocked on owner-authorized PokerAtlas/TableCaptain outreach and legal or terms review.
tickets.nextAction: Owner authorizes and completes PokerAtlas/TableCaptain outreach and legal or terms review; Luna records written capabilities and limitations while preserving the accepted manual workflow and shipping no scraper.
acceptanceCriteria: Terms and vendor permission are reviewed.
API/export/webhook capabilities are confirmed in writing.
The v1 manual reconciliation workflow is documented if no integration exists.
No scraper ships on an unverified legal assumption.

tickets.title: Approve legal and stored-value policies
tickets.summary: Counsel and CPA decisions are needed for the member agreement, privacy/terms updates, time-bank expiration, refunds, and Texas unclaimed-property posture.
tickets.nextAction: Owner obtains counsel and CPA decisions for the member agreement and e-sign, identity retention, tournament seat-fee and rake posture, time-bank expiration, refunds, escheatment and tax, and TABC language; Luna converts only approved answers into ADR, spec, and acceptance-test changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Member agreement text is approved.
Time-bank refund and expiration rules are approved.
Stored-value and sales-tax posture is recorded.
TABC permit language is added when available.

tickets.title: Finish production and ownership hygiene
tickets.summary: PR #54 documented the verified production posture and exact owner-only gaps; domain redirects, repository visibility, named platform owners and recovery access, and vector-asset deferral still require owner decisions.
tickets.nextAction: Owner confirms primary and redirect domain behavior, repository visibility, named GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase owners plus recovery access, and whether the vector master stays deferred for web or is required before print; Luna applies only approved configuration and documentation changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The primary domain and redirect domain are confirmed.
Repository visibility is appropriate for auth and payment code.
Production deployment and database owners are documented.
Launch-grade vector assets are available or explicitly deferred.

tickets.title: Ship membership billing lifecycle
tickets.summary: Implement signup billing, autopay/invoice pricing, webhooks, dunning, cancel, and reactivate on the existing auth and payment substrate.
tickets.nextAction: After atomic QA, payment access and configuration, and legal and pricing gates clear, cut red-first signup, subscription, webhook, dunning, cancel, and reactivate slices and run real test-mode E2E.
acceptanceCriteria: Autopay and invoice signup complete in test mode.
Webhook replay is idempotent.
Membership state follows Stripe.
Cancel, reactivate, and past-due paths pass E2E.

tickets.title: Ship member ID verification
tickets.summary: Complete upload, review, approval/rejection, re-verification, and retention behavior using the approved identity path.
tickets.nextAction: After atomic QA and the owner and counsel identity decisions, write the upload, manual-review, approval, rejection, reverification, and retention matrix and ship against authorized storage and review access.
acceptanceCriteria: Members can complete the approved verification flow.
Managers can review without exposing documents to lower roles.
Retention and deletion jobs match policy.
Approval/rejection and audit writes are atomic.

tickets.title: Ship time-bank and cashier operations
tickets.summary: Complete purchases, promo credit, idempotent redemption, manual adjustments, balance views, and daily reconciliation.
tickets.nextAction: After atomic QA, payment lifecycle, and stored-value policy gates clear, split schema, ledger, cashier, and reconciliation work and prove idempotent redemption plus full wallet rebuild.
acceptanceCriteria: A $200 purchase credits the approved promo balance.
A duplicate redemption cannot double-charge time.
The append-only ledger can rebuild the wallet balance.
Cashier permissions and reconciliation E2E pass.

tickets.title: Ship paid tournament registration
tickets.summary: Extend the live schedule with member registration, capacity/waitlist handling, entry payment, cancellation, and refund behavior.
tickets.nextAction: Complete the live schedule rollout, atomic QA, payment configuration and lifecycle, and tournament legal and refund decisions; then specify and build concurrency-safe registration, waitlist, payment, cancellation, and refund flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Capacity and waitlist transitions are concurrency-safe.
Entry payment and registration are idempotent.
Cancellation/refund rules match approved policy.
Member and admin E2E flows pass.

tickets.title: Ship transactional communications
tickets.summary: Deliver receipts, low-balance alerts, tournament reminders, delivery tracking, and opt-out handling after provider gates clear.
tickets.nextAction: After communication access and registration plus the upstream revenue flows are complete, implement tested email-first templates and idempotent retries; add SMS only where registration and consent authorize it.
acceptanceCriteria: Receipts and operational alerts render from tested templates.
Retries do not duplicate messages.
STOP/HELP and consent state are enforced.
Email-only degradation is documented and tested.
